If the implementer finds documented intent that serve/build are deliberately single-schema commands, report the fork instead of hard-coding either reading.

Premise re-verified on `origin/main`: `serve.ts:26` / `build.ts:31` still `join(cwd, 'pages')` only.

Serial constraint for the dispatching seat: #3890 is in flight (PR #4922) on the same command files — hard serial; dispatch only after it lands, and re-verify this card's file face on the merged ref.

Size/model suggestion: M, opus.
